proofContract.scope: Existing position/acquisition/source joins retain tenant/account/chain/token/signal/source/master/buy provenance. Application tenant uses null-safe identity; nullable/missing position_id fails the inner join. Evidence PK and application evidence PK do not multiply lot rows.
proofContract.quantity: lot.remaining_quantity::text still copied verbatim to openQuantityExact; no Number-derived exact fallback.
proofContract.omission: Disqualified positive historical lot rows are excluded from the SQL lot rowset. The existing fallback emits only diagnostic aggregate fields when no qualifying lot remains for a ledger; no positionKey, openQuantityExact, masterWalletAddress, targetAccount, or acquisitionExecutionMode is attached. Mixed qualifying/disqualified rowsets do not reintroduce rejected lot identities.
proofContract.preserved: No history repair, new schema, confirmation mutation, verifier enablement, numeric PNL/epsilon policy changes, exit reservation changes, settlement changes, or current-policy/runtime gate bypass.

readOnlySchemaAndProducerReferences.finding: Evidence execution FK and confirmed/finalized/observed/reversed state schema.
Application evidence PK, execution FK, account/chain/token, active.
Application tenant and nullable surrogate position_id; canonical account/chain/token/null-safe tenant backfill.
Independent position/source/execution/evidence FKs do not prove evidence.execution_id equals lot acquisition execution.
Application active is derived from evidence confirmation before lot synchronization.
Synchronization returns for non-applied confirmation; reversal can leave positive historical lot.
Exact snapshot and canonical lot claim/settlement contracts; no legacy aggregate exit authority.
